review:
Beyond Reality, developed by EternalShadow Studios and published by Aldorlea Games, is a story-focused role-playing game that blends fantasy storytelling with science fiction concepts to create an adventure centered around time, consequence, and the fragile balance between technology and nature. Built around traditional RPG design principles, the game embraces classic turn-based systems while introducing a narrative that reaches across centuries. Rather than limiting itself to familiar fantasy themes, it builds a world where ancient magic and futuristic ideas collide, creating an experience driven more by exploration and storytelling than spectacle.

The narrative begins with a catastrophe rooted in the distant past. Thousands of years before the main events unfold, a devastating war destroys the Kingdom of Jastamune, forcing powerful individuals to make desperate choices in order to survive. One of those survivors, the magician Reverent Sulada, escapes destruction through magical preservation only to awaken centuries later in a world transformed by scientific advancement and environmental decline. The future she enters feels unfamiliar and unstable, shaped by pollution, technological influence, and organizations whose actions threaten to reshape the world permanently.

One of the game's more interesting qualities comes from how it approaches larger themes beyond its central adventure. Environmental damage and humanity’s relationship with progress become important ideas woven directly into the story rather than existing as background details. The conflict stretches beyond personal survival and expands toward questions involving responsibility, historical consequences, and whether mistakes from the past can truly be corrected. These themes give the narrative greater ambition than a straightforward fantasy quest.

The world itself benefits from the unusual blend of fantasy and science fiction influences. Ancient magic exists alongside futuristic concepts in ways that create a setting with its own identity. Rather than feeling disconnected, both sides of the worldbuilding support one another to establish an environment where time itself becomes one of the central forces shaping the adventure. The contrast between older traditions and modern technological systems helps maintain curiosity throughout progression.

Gameplay follows traditional role-playing foundations that will feel familiar to fans of classic RPG experiences. Exploration drives advancement as players travel through different regions, interact with characters, uncover information, and gradually piece together the larger mystery surrounding the world’s condition. Towns, story locations, and dangerous areas each contribute toward progression while encouraging players to engage with the setting rather than rushing directly toward objectives.

Combat relies on turn-based mechanics built around strategy and resource management. Battles reward preparation and thoughtful decision-making rather than speed or reflexes. Players develop party members over time, unlocking additional options and strengthening combat capabilities as progression continues. The structure remains intentionally traditional, leaning into older RPG design philosophies rather than modern action-heavy systems.

Character development remains one of the stronger aspects of the experience. Progression systems steadily expand player possibilities while supporting experimentation with party growth and combat approaches. Building stronger characters creates satisfying long-term progression, particularly for players who enjoy methodical development systems instead of immediate power progression.

Storytelling remains the primary focus throughout the adventure. Dialogue and narrative sequences receive considerable attention, reinforcing the game's emphasis on worldbuilding and character interaction. Relationships and conversations carry weight because much of the emotional investment comes through understanding motivations and discovering how different individuals fit within the larger conflict.

The visual presentation reflects the game’s independent origins while embracing a style familiar to players who appreciate classic role-playing design. Environmental layouts and presentation choices prioritize atmosphere and functionality rather than technical complexity. While it may not deliver visual spectacle associated with larger productions, the artistic direction supports the tone of the adventure effectively.

Music contributes positively to immersion as well. The soundtrack reinforces emotional moments while helping establish atmosphere during exploration and story progression. Audio presentation strengthens quieter scenes and larger narrative developments without overwhelming the overall experience.

The game’s commitment to older role-playing traditions may not appeal equally to every player. Modern audiences accustomed to faster pacing and streamlined systems may occasionally find progression slower than expected. Dialogue-heavy sections and traditional mechanics require patience, particularly for players seeking constant action or more contemporary RPG structures.

Some systems also reveal limitations associated with smaller independent projects. Certain areas may lack polish compared to larger productions, and pacing occasionally prioritizes narrative depth over gameplay intensity. However, those willing to embrace its design philosophy will likely find value in its ambition and creativity.

What ultimately helps Beyond Reality stand apart is its willingness to pursue ideas beyond standard fantasy storytelling. The combination of time manipulation, environmental themes, science fiction influences, and traditional role-playing mechanics creates an experience that feels distinct despite familiar foundations.

Players who enjoy narrative-driven RPGs, classic turn-based systems, and adventures built around larger themes rather than simple hero-versus-villain conflicts will likely find plenty to appreciate. Beyond Reality succeeds through creativity and ambition, delivering a journey that values storytelling and atmosphere as much as progression systems.

A thoughtful role-playing adventure that successfully combines fantasy and science fiction while delivering strong narrative ideas, satisfying traditional RPG mechanics, and a world built around meaningful themes and exploration.

В ходе перемещения по маршруту возникает непредвиденное препятствие в виде пешехода, что приводит к фатальному дорожно-транспортному происшествию с участием нашего транспортного средства. 🎮 《Beyond Reality》游戏简评

《Beyond Reality》是一款由 EternalShadow Studios 开发、Aldorlea Games 发行的 RPGMaker 引擎角色扮演游戏，于 2016 年 1 月 8 日在 Steam 平台发布。游戏融合了科幻与奇幻元素，讲述了主角 La'lele 与其团队穿越时空，揭示古代王国秘密并阻止战争的故事。

🕹️ 游戏玩法与特色
时空穿越的剧情设定：玩家将跟随 Alpha Omega 公司成员，穿越至两千年前的 Jastamune 王国，探索其灭亡的真相，并尝试改变历史。

经典回合制战斗系统：采用传统的回合制战斗，玩家需合理搭配角色技能与装备，策略性地应对敌人。

丰富的探索与解谜元素：游戏中包含大量的支线任务和隐藏内容，鼓励玩家深入探索每个区域，发现隐藏的故事线索。

独特的视觉风格：虽然基于 RPGMaker 引擎，但游戏在美术设计上投入颇多，呈现出独特的视觉体验。

✅ 优点
引人入胜的剧情：游戏的故事设定新颖，时空穿越与历史改变的主题使人沉浸其中。

丰富的游戏内容：除了主线任务外，还有大量的支线任务和隐藏要素，增加了游戏的可玩性。

良好的音乐与音效：游戏的背景音乐与音效设计得当，增强了游戏的氛围感。

❌ 缺点
角色塑造略显薄弱：部分玩家反映角色性格刻画不够深入，难以产生情感共鸣。

战斗难度偏低：对于经验丰富的 RPG 玩家而言，游戏的战斗挑战性可能不足。

技术限制：由于使用 RPGMaker 引擎，游戏在画面表现和系统复杂性上存在一定限制。

🎯 总结
《Beyond Reality》是一款融合了科幻与奇幻元素的独立角色扮演游戏，适合喜欢探索丰富剧情和世界观的玩家。尽管在技术层面存在一些限制，但其引人入胜的故事和丰富的游戏内容仍值得一试。

⭐ 综合评分：3.5 / 5
推荐给喜欢剧情驱动型 RPG 的玩家，尤其是对时空穿越和历史改变题材感兴趣的玩家。对于追求高难度战斗和复杂系统的玩家，可能不太适合。

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

RPG Maker strikes again!

Beyond Reality is one of hundreds of low effort retro-pixel RPG Maker asset/construction kit flips spamming the Steam catalog, made with the RPG Maker video game construction kit... in their own words, "Our easy to use tools are simple enough for a child."  Like all RPG Maker "games", this is essentially a bunch of low quality/canned assets from RPG Maker coupled with a cringeworthy high school anime club fan fiction.

This is another RPG Maker asset flip/cash grab from Andorlea/Warfare/SimProse/Valkyria/EternalShadow Studios.  It's important to note that this guy has rushed over OVER ONE HUNDRED of these RPG Maker asset flips onto Steam, now.  This isn't sincere, genuine game development.  This is a cash grab scheme.  While it's refreshing to see they almost but not quite escaped the generic fantasy anime fanfic theme of almost all of their games... here, you're from the past, and you travel into the future!  Then back into the past so you can go straight into a generic fantasy anime fanfic RPG Maker asset flip.  So much for that.  The shovelware never ends with these guys, and neither does the mediocrity.  This has all the same hallmarks as all their other asset flips, regardless of which fake/shell accounts they use to try hide their identity, which means bad map design, bad encounter design, bugs, badly translated writing, spelling and grammatical errors... it's just another series in their 100+ and counting RPG Maker asset flip shovelware library.

As with all RPG Maker games, the poor quality engine displays badly in fullscreen and doesn't have full HD support or any graphics tweaking options, making this unacceptable for any dedicated modern PC gamer.  The point can be made that the intention of RPG Maker is to make demos and small games to pass around friends, and shouldn't be used for "professional" game development.

Like most RPG Maker shovelware and asset flips, the game features extremely low quality copy + pasted 2D retro pixel art, looks awful, and has even worse gameplay.  RPG Maker is an absolutely terrible construction kit, and never results in games of any reasonable quality or value to gamers.

You don't have to take my word about how bad the game is, we can measure the interest in a game by how much people bothered to play it.  Beyond Reality has achievements, and they show us a very clear picture that the game absolutely failed to capture any interest from gamers.  The most commonly and easily attained achievement is explosion, but only around 3 percent of players bothered to get that far before uninstalling the game.  That's a tiny, tiny proportion of gamers who even bothered with this.  Ouch.

Reviewing SteamDB to check how popular this game was with players reveals a surprise... there's a very healthy spike in player counts for the game.  But this isn't consistent with the achievement stats, that show only 3 percent of players bothered playing the game for any reasonable amount of time.  How is it possible for this game to have so many concurrent players who weren't even playing the game?  Trading cards.  Players will use card idling software to collect the cards and sell them, but this won't trigger any achievements in-game.  That tells us people only really bought this game for trading cards, and that's a damning indictment of the woeful quality.  A closer look at the numbers shows the game just has a couple of players every week running up the game and idling it for cards, then deleting it.  We must ask how it benefits gamers for there to be so many games like this, with no merit as a serious game, that only generate sales from people idling and selling the trading cards.

Beyond Reality has the insane price of around $5 USD, it's not worth it given the defects and shortcomings with the product.  Gamers who want a good retro JRPG experience would be better off playing the originals, like Final Fantasy, Star Ocean or Chrono Trigger.

Beyond Reality, oyuncuları zaman ve uzayda bir yolculuğa çıkaran bir bilim kurgu ve fantezi macera oyunudur. Oyun, geleceğin kirlilik dolu dünyasını incelemeye adanmış bir grup araştırmacı olan Alpha Omega Company'nin hikayesini takip ediyor. İki bin yıldır yapılan bir büyüye rastladıklarında, uzun zamandır unutulmuş bir savaştan sağ kurtulan tek kişi olan büyücü Reverent Sulada'yı uyandırırlar. Zamanda geri gittiklerinde savaşı önlemek ve tarihin akışını değiştirmek zorundadırlar.

Oyun, oyuncuların gizli patronlar da dahil olmak üzere 50'den fazla farklı düşmanla savaşa girmesine olanak tanıyan sıra tabanlı bir savaş sistemine sahiptir. Oyuncular ayrıca savaşta kendilerine yardımcı olması için 30'dan fazla farklı türde silah ve zırh toplayabilir ve yükseltebilirler. Oyun, ana görevin yanı sıra oyuncuların takımlarının güç ve kuvvetlerini geliştirmelerine yardımcı olan yan görevler de içeriyor.

Beyond Reality zengin bir hikaye ve keşfedilmeye değer detaylı bir dünya sunuyor. Altı ila sekiz saatlik oynanış süresiyle oyun, hem zorlu hem de ilgi çekici, sürükleyici bir deneyim sunuyor. Oyunda ayrıca sürpriz bir unsur ekleyen ve oynanışı taze tutan harita üzerinde karşılaşmalar da yer alıyor. Sonuç olarak Beyond Reality, bilim kurgu ve fantezi hayranlarını memnun edeceği kesin olan, iyi hazırlanmış bir macera oyunu.
